tools.name: audit_landing_page
tools.description: Loads a public landing page in a real browser (desktop and mobile), and returns a conversion score from 0 to 100, seven sub-scores (clarity, value proposition, CTA, trust, design, mobile, SEO basics), the top 3 issues with concrete fixes, what already works, a short AI-readiness score, and fix_promp

tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: Fetches a public page as a normal browser and as GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User and PerplexityBot, then reports which AI bots are blocked or get a challenge page, the robots.txt rule for each AI bot, how much text is visible without JavaScript, JSON-LD types, sitemap, Ma

tools.name: get_audit_result
tools.description: Returns the current result of an audit started with audit_landing_page, by its audit_id. Use it only when audit_landing_page returned status "running"; wait about 20 seconds between calls. Returns the same fields as audit_landing_page.

tools.name: recheck_landing_page
tools.description: Runs a fresh capture of the page behind an earlier full report bought with the same API key, then returns the new result plus `comparison`: every check marked cleared, improved_still_failing, unchanged, regressed, newly_failing or unable_to_verify against that baseline. Use it after the fixes from f

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "audit_landing_page" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
